description: **A plan/ branch closes proposal rows on no evidence**: `proposal_row_problems` in `warscape/policy.py` lets `plan/` close an accepted row as `moved` with its job not done, and a tagged open row as `gone`, with no record behind either. Decide whether a close must name a record that shows it. Why: `plan/` merges itself, so a question can go before the owner sees it, or a decline can lose its suppression. Depends on W45 merging. From W45 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: A plan/ branch closes proposal rows on no evidence
